name: Imperial Guard Remnants
source: Mord Hive v0.5, pp.039-041 (Imperial Guard Remnants). Statlines and costs transcribed from the datasheets on p.041; equipment lists from p.040. On selecting the warband you choose one of three regiments — Cadia, Catachan or Vostroyan First Born — whose special rules are recorded in `specialRules` below. The base list here is regiment-agnostic; regiment-specific modifiers (Cadian Marksmen +1 BS and Leader 12"; Catachan Officers/NCOs start S4; Vostroyan +1 to find rare items and 600 starting thrones) are applied by the player per that choice. specialRules: Imperial Guard Remnants. On selecting the warband, choose one of three regiments: CADIA - fighters may use the Officer's Leadership within 12" (rather than 6"), and all Marksmen add +1 to Ballistic Skill (BS3 -> BS4), whether recruited at the start or later. CATACHAN - the Officers and Non-Commissioned Officers start with Strength 4 instead of Strength 3. VOSTROYAN FIRST BORN - receive a +1 bonus when attempting to find rare items (see Trading), and start with an extra 100 thrones (600 total) in a campaign (or an extra 20% thrones when recruiting for a one-off game). Min warband size 3, max 15.
